description: Select full rows by one typed comparison while keeping original positions and encounter order.

interface.semantic_input: An ordered producer of finite rows with UTF-8 text fields and source positions. Integer operands in this scope are signed decimal texts in the signed 64-bit range.
interface.semantic_output: An encounter-ordered subsequence of full input rows, with unchanged fields and source positions.

implementation_form: retained authored adapter over DuckDB comparison query
resources: The visited producer is materialized into a local in-memory table before row delivery. The configured DuckDB memory limit is 64 MB. Process memory and scaling remain unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: Supply valid zero-based columns, a supported typed comparison, and valid UTF-8 text in this scope. Field mode interprets the value as a column index. Integer comparisons require signed decimal operands in range.

postconditions.detail: Across four operand modes and six comparators, outputs kept exactly the selected full rows, including duplicates and their original positions in encounter order.

refinements.detail: The fixtures distinguish text from integer ordering, signed decimal spellings, range endpoints, operand order and case-sensitive text equality.

effects.detail: The typed CLI wrote outputs on success. Its tested missing-column and invalid-integer failures preserved a pre-existing destination and left an absent destination absent.

invariants.detail: Two sequential visits to the same producer agreed on the tested input. No read occurred during filter construction.

mathematical_properties.detail: No universal subsequence proof or rewrite law was established.

formal_predicates.detail: The fixture domain describes tested operand modes and representation. No formal proof over all rows is claimed.

state_protocol.detail: Invalid comparison, type or index syntax failed at creation. Tested missing fields and malformed or out-of-range integer operands failed during visitation, before any emitted row.

ownership.detail: The result captures the source closure by value. A visitor borrows delivered field storage during its callback.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent visits and arbitrary side effects of upstream producers were not tested.

upstream_usage.detail: The adapter submits a SELECT with a typed predicate and encounter order to DuckDB. The retained kernel exports the extracted PhysicalFilter symbol.

specification_question.detail: Which column, comparison and operand should decide which rows remain? Should the operand be interpreted as text, an integer, or another column?
